records.title: Falkenhausen followup: a surviving second-part ending
records.meaning: The surviving ending appears to promise that something will follow as soon as possible, with Falkenhausen and reference 8274/18. The subject of folgen is not present in this part. The literal defective words BAL and MOEGLIHST are preserved; the interpretation as bald moeglichst is not an additional cryptographic recovery.
records.reading_note: All 78 received coordinates decode directly. The first part has not been identified here. No missing D or C is inserted to normalize BAL MOEGLIHST, and no link to the neighboring food dispatch is asserted.

records.title: A telegram reports the Turkish armistice, with terms still unknown
records.meaning: The message reports that Turkey concluded an armistice today at one o'clock in the afternoon and says its terms are not yet known. This is the content of the intercepted report; it does not independently establish the historically effective time. The page is headed 31 October, and reception is recorded on 1 November.
